response.headline: Put the changed term into the renewal already in flight.
response.hypothesis: A meaningful vendor term changed while the accountable owner field still points to someone who left, leaving a high-value production relationship unable to absorb drift.
response.alternative: LedgerLoop may still provide advance notice contractually even though the public wording changed.
response.recommendation: Assign the business owner now and extend CON-204 with the notice-term question; route any acceptance of online-only notice to the Controller before the renewal window closes.
tradeoffs: Keeps the production close workflow stable
Consumes negotiation time inside a 21-day window
conditions: Controller accepts or rejects the changed notice mechanism
missing: Whether the signed agreement preserves 30-day notice
response.changes_mind: A signed clause preserving advance notice would reduce this to an ownership correction.
